Name: Item Bags for Nature in the Valley (and all expansions)
Author: sankayoudead
Description:
This addon was created to suit my own playthrough - and because I had to catch 'em all, these bags came to existence (originally just the AIO one, but you can now download each expansion separately as well if you want). 

[b]Contents:[/b]

All-In-One Bag - contains every creature from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature in the Valley[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31099]Dark Creatures and Cuties[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32011]Integrated Wildlife[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18928]Leaf Collecting[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30868]Buggy Bugs[/url] (purchasable at Travelling Cart)
(Optional) Nature in the Valley Bag - for storing critters from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30138]Nature in the Valley[/url] without any addons (purchasable at Travelling Cart)
(Optional) Dark Creatures and Cuties Bag - for storing cuties from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31099]Dark Creatures and Cuties[/url] expansion (purchasable at Travelling Cart)
(Optional) Integrated Wildlife Bag - for storing crawlies from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32011]Integrated Wildlife[/url] expansion (purchasable at Travelling Cart)
(Optional) Leaf Collecting Bag - for storing leaves from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18928]Leaf Collecting[/url] expansion (purchasable at Travelling Cart)
(Optional) Buggy Buggs Bag - for storing menaces from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30868]Buggy Bugs[/url]﻿ expansion; Cocroach is originally both in Integrated Wildlife and Buggy bags, so I plopped it here (Bugs Bunny approved, purchasable at Travelling Cart)

[b]Installation:[/b]

Simply extract the JSON file from the provided ZIP archive into your ...Mods\ItemBags\assets\Modded Bags folder. (EDIT: Amended directory structure in the zip archive, so you can simply drag the ItemBags folder in your Mods folder. )

All credit goes to w8AwA8w, xAncAx and SiTheGreat1 - thank you for the permission and enabling my Pokémon hoarding. <3
